title: Process rules and the plan file have one owner each
body:
Why: t-0a9xgwe (91d97e1) left two duplications: PLAN.md and PLANS.md, and process rules repeated across docs/, AGENTS.md and spec/rules.json (its close note).
Outcome: one owner per process rule and one plan file; the others point to it (D19).
Proof: grep shows each rule text once; npm run fast passes.
Scope: docs/, AGENTS.md, spec/rules.json, PLAN.md, PLANS.md, test/rules/.
